spec.name: Full Send Dragon Tower
spec.description: Dark basalt casino cabinet with orange-gold fittings, emerald seals and stepped dragon horns. Geometry stays within 0..16 for runtime stretching to 3×4×1 blocks. The blank recessed front at Z=1 leaves X=1..15, Y=2..14 clear for the plugin's door grid.

prompt: Minecraft voxel casino Dragon Tower cabinet, fantasy dark basalt stone tower with warm orange gold trim, green emerald safe motifs and dragon horn silhouette at top. Physical 3-block wide by 4-block tall by 1-block deep cabinet. IMPORTANT model coordinates all within 0..16 on all axes; runtime stretches to (3,4,1). Front is negative Z; blank recessed face near Z=1 for a 4 column by 9 row door grid added by plugin, no baked door grid or text. Side columns and crown ornate but leave x=1..15,y=2..14 face clear. Base sturdy. Vanilla pixel texture 64x64.
